title: Imza configuration
description: User configuration for Imza, read from and written back to <data-dir>/config.json (see `imza --config`). Unknown keys are ignored on read; every key here is optional.

providers.description: Provider connections. Two entries sharing an id are disambiguated by label, whose identity becomes `id/label`.

models.description: Model selection for the main conversation and for each subagent role.

main.description: Active model. `model` requires a `provider` that resolves to a connection.

global.description: Skill name to policy, for globally discovered skills.

projects.description: Project root path to its own skill policy map.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers keyed by id. An http entry needs either an http(s) `url` or a `catalog_id` referring to the bundled catalogue (an explicit `url` wins); a stdio entry needs a `command`.

allow.description: Permissions granted automatically at startup, in addition to `--allow-dir` and `--allow-cmd`. A grant here still subjects every request to Imza's normal evaluation.

directories.description: Directories whose files and subdirectories the agent may read and edit without asking. Absolute paths, or relative to the working directory at startup. Entries that are missing or not a directory are skipped, so a stale entry never blocks startup.

commands.description: Shell programs the agent may run without asking. Omitting `subcommand` approves every subcommand of that program; naming one approves only that pair.

instructions.description: Extra instruction files appended to the system prompt after AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or GEMINI.md. Paths are relative to the project root, or to the working directory when there is no root; absolute paths are used as given. Missing files are skipped. Each file is capped at 32 KiB.

id.description: Provider identity, required and non-empty. Combined with `label` into the connection key `id/label`.

provider_id.description: Deprecated alias for `id`, used only when `id` is absent.

endpoint.description: Custom base URL, e.g. a local Ollama endpoint. Empty for hosted providers.

refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token for subscription providers.

label.description: Disambiguates several connections sharing an id. Duplicates are relabelled deterministically on load.

provider.description: Connection key that serves this model.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort. Defaults per role: builder `medium` (stored as `default`), researcher `low`, basic `off`.

skillPolicy.description: Whether a skill loads silently, asks each time, or is refused.

subcommand.description: Restricts the grant to this subcommand. Absent approves all of them; an empty string is a configuration error.

type.description: Transport. Defaults to "http". A stdio server runs `command` as a local child process instead of connecting to a url.

catalog_id.description: Reference to a bundled catalogue server whose url and label resolve at use time.

url.description: Custom endpoint. Must be http(s); plain http is upgraded to https.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers. Names must be non-empty and contain no colon.

oauth.description: Browser sign-in state; written by Imza after a successful OAuth sign-in.

command.description: Program to run for a stdio server. Passed verbatim (no shell); looked up on PATH. Required when `type` is "stdio".

args.description: Arguments for a stdio server's command.

env.description: Environment variables for a stdio server, merged over the inherited environment.

working_directory.description: Working directory for a stdio server's process.

enabled.description: Whether the server is active. Defaults to true. An inactive server never connects and is reported as INACTIVE.

autoload.description: Connect this server automatically at startup. Defaults to false; only enabled servers are eligible.

timeout_secs.description: Per-request timeout override. 0 uses the client default of 25 seconds; negative values are rejected.
